messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Zenith's March invoice (INV-2026-3292) missing the compute usage line. Service fee line present but shows $0. Customer flagged us. @Jon can you pick this up? batch=8205

Jon: On it. Do we have the invoice preview ID and any render logs?

Maya: Preview ID pvw-7781. Pasted the relevant chunk from the invoice-generator logs below:
```
2026-03-25T02:13:04Z ERROR invoice-renderer batch=8205 cust=zenith render: line_items=[]
2026-03-25T02:13:04Z WARN pricing engine: applied policy percentile_pricing_v2 -> proration_ratio=0.0000
2026-03-25T02:13:04Z INFO invoice-renderer: service_fee amount=0 (stubbbed)
```

Aditi: Customer also said they saw two preview PDFs earlier, one duplicate, then the final invoice was lower than their expected usage total. They kept screenshots.

billing-bot: Invoice generation job 8205 completed with warnings: zero_amount_line, duplicate-preview-detected

Stripe Connector: No webhook or payout errors on our end for Zenith in that window.

Jon: Hm. The log shows percentile_pricing_v2 proration_ratio=0.0000 — that could reduce small compute line items to zero after rounding. We rolled that flag to a small % last week for the pricing experiment.

Maya: Can you confirm if Zenith was in the sample? I can check flagging if you tell me the query.

Jon: Run: `curl -sS https://flags.internal/api/v1/percentile_pricing_v2?env=prod&customer=zenith`

Maya: Ran it, response: `{ "enabled": true, "rollout_pct": 7, "reason": "perf/percentile-pricing-experiment" }` — Zenith is in the 7% cohort.

Jon: Ok that's our culprit. Two quick actions: 1) rollback flag for prod, 2) re-render invoices for affected accounts (start with Zenith). Settle credits if the final charged amount was lower than expected or lines disappeared.

Aditi: Customer requests a corrected invoice PDF and a credit for the missing compute usage if they were undercharged. We should also check whether any customers were overcharged due to duplicate previews.

Jon: Rolling back now: `flagsctl set percentile_pricing_v2 prod off --initiator jon`

billing-bot: Flag change recorded: percentile_pricing_v2 -> OFF by jon @ 2026-03-25T02:30:12Z (audit id fa-99312)

Jon: Triggering re-render job: `billing-run --rerender-invoices --batch 8205 --reason "experiment rollback"`

billing-bot: Re-render job 8210 queued for batch 8205 (includes INV-2026-3292).

Maya: I'll prepare a customer note and draft the corrected PDF when it's ready. Aditi, please confirm the credit amount to issue once we have the rerender output.

Aditi: Tentative credit for Zenith: compute missing $312.45 + automatic rounding adjustment. I'll open FIN ticket and record approvals.

Maya: Created ticket FIN-5123 (corrected invoice & credit) and assigned to Jon + Aditi.

Jon: Re-render finished successfully, job 8210 -> invoice regenerated with compute line restored. New invoice INV-2026-3292-v2 and credit memo CM-2026-77 created.

billing-bot: Notification: invoice INV-2026-3292-v2 emailed to billing@zenith.co and credit CM-2026-77 scheduled.

Aditi: Confirmed with customer. They've received corrected PDF and credit memo. They asked for root cause — can we share that the pricing experiment caused proration to zero out small compute lines and we've rolled it back?

Jon: Yes, brief postmortem: experiment flag percentile_pricing_v2 caused aggressive proration/rounding. We'll add guardrails: don't zero lines below $1 and add canary metrics for invoice line count.

Maya: Thanks team. Closing this thread once FIN-5123 shows as resolved. :white_check_mark:
